scenes.title: Dubosc en plein doute  (Dubosc in Doubt)
scenes.summary: On a demanding arthouse film set, Gabriel visits Franck Dubosc, who feels ridiculed by his young co-star and misunderstood by the director, threatening to quit both the shoot and the agency.

scenes.title: La bataille des talents  (The Battle for Talent)
scenes.summary: At ASK, Andrea urges the junior agents to show confidence as they fight to retain Mathias's former stars, knowing that losing marquee names like Dany Boon would bankrupt the agency.

scenes.title: Nouveaux bureaux  (New Offices)
scenes.summary: Gabriel attempts to build bridges with young star Dylan Charif, while Mathias and Noémie set up their new production suite at StarMédia under the watchful eye of Igor de Serisy.

scenes.title: L'offre de Mathias  (Mathias's Offer)
scenes.summary: Andrea meets producer Mathias to negotiate terms for Fabrice Luchini and Sofia Leprince, only for Mathias to make an aggressive lowball offer and threaten to steer Dany Boon away from ASK.

scenes.title: La perle rare  (The Rare Pearl)
scenes.summary: Camille struggles to find an expressive actress for Valérie Donzelli's film, until Arlette advises her to seek authentic talent on the street, leading Camille to remember an encounter with a Spanish tourist in the metro.

scenes.title: La promotion de Noémie  (Noémie's Promotion)
scenes.summary: At lunch in Mathias Barneville's new production offices, Noémie asserts her new executive role amid office gossip and awkward workplace affection.

scenes.title: Le savon de Gabriel  (Gabriel's Lecture)
scenes.summary: Franck Dubosc angrily confronts Gabriel over a press interview, but Gabriel challenges him to step out of his comfort zone, convincing Franck to accept him as his official agent.

scenes.title: L'héritière de Barneville  (The Barneville Heiress)
scenes.summary: While preparing their housewarming party, Camille consults Hervé about Mathias's formal paternity recognition, and Hervé humorously calculates her future inheritance.

scenes.title: L'attente au café  (Waiting at the Café)
scenes.summary: Waiting impatiently at a café for Nathalie Baye, Andréa trades banter with a cheeky waiter before discovering that Mathias intercepted her client.

scenes.title: Le feng shui de Nathalie  (Nathalie's Feng Shui)
scenes.summary: Mathias escorts Nathalie Baye to ASK where she energetically rearranges the sublet law office, and Andréa arrives to negotiate representation.

scenes.title: Chez Madame Bonnero  (At Madame Bonnero's)
scenes.summary: Andréa travels to Bergues to visit Dany Boon's mother, Madame Bonnero, hoping to keep the star at ASK. Madame Bonnero urges her to slow down and insists on sharing a hearty meal before talking business.

scenes.title: Coincée à Bergues  (Stuck in Bergues)
scenes.summary: Full after an enormous northern feast with Madame Bonnero, Andréa calls Colette to confess she cannot make their date night because she traveled all the way to Bergues, leaving Colette furious at home.

scenes.title: L'avenir de l'agence  (The Future of the Agency)
scenes.summary: Gabriel confronts producer Mathias about his secret negotiations with star client Dany Boon. Gabriel warns that losing Dany could sink ASK, then frantically tries to reach Franck Dubosc by phone.

scenes.title: L'orthophoniste secret  (The Secret Speech Therapist)
scenes.summary: Outside the community center, Gabriel tries to blackmail Dylan into withdrawing his assault complaint by threatening to accuse him of dealing drugs, but Franck Dubosc intervenes to reveal the man was actually Dylan's speech therapist.

scenes.title: Quittes pour une gifle  (Even for a Slap)
scenes.summary: Hoping to clear the air after their violent altercation on set, Franck Dubosc offers Dylan the chance to slap him in the face so they can be even.

scenes.title: Pardon pour mon agent  (Apology for My Agent)
scenes.summary: Franck Dubosc apologizes to Dylan for Gabriel's clumsy meddling, explaining why he remains loyal to his well-meaning agent while wondering why Dylan secretly sees a speech therapist.

scenes.title: La zone de confort  (The Comfort Zone)
scenes.summary: In a quiet corner at the party, young César winner Dylan confesses his imposter syndrome and fear of taking on different roles. Veteran comic Franck Dubosc shares his own bizarre career beginnings to inspire Dylan to embrace every challenge without fear.

scenes.title: Le frère jumeau d'Ozon  (Ozon's Twin Brother)
scenes.summary: At the party, Franck Dubosc teases Sophia with an absurd prank, convincing her that director François Ozon alternates shoot days with a fictional twin brother Gilles. Sophia laughs off the joke, and Franck praises her naive sincerity.

scenes.title: Le prix du métier  (The Price of the Trade)
scenes.summary: On a late-night phone call, Élise Formet confirms that Dany Boon will sign with Mathias. Despite securing the star, Mathias feels disillusioned when Élise questions the cynicism and manipulation required by their profession.

scenes.title: Une visite inattendue  (An Unexpected Visit)
scenes.summary: Late at night in the empty ASK offices, Andréa pours herself a drink to unwind after a grueling day. Suddenly, rival StarMédia agent Élise Formain appears in her doorway and asks for a glass, startling Andréa.

scenes.title: Une trahison amère  (A Bitter Betrayal)
scenes.summary: Sipping her drink in Andréa's office, Élise Formain bitterly confesses that she was passed over for the leadership of StarMédia. Despite her superior competence, the board appointed Olivier Dimars simply because he is a man.

scenes.title: Le départ de Dany Boon  (Dany Boon's Departure)
scenes.summary: Andréa questions Élise about the true motive behind her late-night visit, only for Élise to drop a devastating bombshell: Dany Boon is leaving ASK to join StarMédia. Mathias has orchestrated the defection, leaving Andréa reeling from the betrayal.

scenes.title: La fête à Saint-Ouen  (The Party in Saint-Ouen)
scenes.summary: As the party at ASK winds down, Sarah thanks Camille before Gabriel eagerly invites her to join an exciting afterparty in Saint-Ouen. Sarah accepts the invitation and they head out together into the night.

scenes.title: À la recherche de Gabriel  (Looking for Gabriel)
scenes.summary: Following her successful audition with Luchini, Sofia arrives late at the nearly empty agency party. Looking around the deserted desks, she urgently asks Camille where Gabriel has gone.

scenes.title: Le départ de Gabriel  (Gabriel's Departure)
scenes.summary: Camille gently breaks the news to Sofia that Gabriel has just left with Sarah for Saint-Ouen. Hiding her heartbreak behind polite smiles, Sofia masks her sorrow and slips away alone into the Paris night as the episode concludes.
